# Lorentz profile air-broadened at 500 hPa, the 15 um band's reference pressure, cut 25 cm^-1
# from its centre (its far wings its continuum's, H2O_CONTINUUM); its strength at each

# spectral bins from 2,500 to 6,500 cm^-1 the spectrum's median (Williams 2026's way) and its
# mean, which a bin's lines broadened into each other absorb at most.
#
# T t_1 t_2 ... (K)
